title: Give it a GHO
tagline: Give it a GHO thought as a platform like Gitcoin that enables donations in GHO, uses a GHO facilitator upon minting GHOs at depositing.
description: Give it a GHO thought as a platform like Gitcoin that enables donations in GHO, uses a GHO facilitator upon minting GHOs at depositing. I havent started it unfortunately due to my busy schedule. Smart contracts would have been written in Solidity, frontend would have used Family SDK, written in typescript using Next.js.
